title: Chapter 2 A Sensible Daughter
content:
Chapter 2 A Sensible Daughter

Hearing this familiar voice, Lu Daosheng's face suddenly turned happy.

The next moment, a girl pushed the door open and came in.

"Xiaoxue, you're back."

Seeing this girl, a loving smile suddenly appeared on Lu Daosheng's face.

This girl is his daughter.

Lu Xue.

"Dad, this wine?"

At this time, Lu Xue noticed the slags of the wine bottle beside Lu Daosheng and hesitated.

Upon hearing this, Lu Daosheng laughed.

"It's okay, it was broken by my father accidentally. At worst, just buy another bottle."

Now that I have such an invincible system, will I care about a mere bottle of broken wine?

However, seeing Lu Daosheng's indifferent appearance, Lu Xue felt extremely uncomfortable.

She knew that this was my father's favorite wine, but now she deliberately didn't care.

Thinking of this, Lu Xue felt inexplicably sad.

Immediately, Lu Xue took out a small wooden box with exquisite carvings on it, as if saying that it is of great value.

"Happy birthday, Dad, this is the gift my daughter has prepared for you."

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng took the wooden box and then smiled and said, "Haha, my daughter has grown up."

"Dad, don't you see what it is?"

Lu Daosheng shook his head.

"What it is doesn't matter, what's important is that it was given to me by my daughter, that's enough."

Hearing this, Lu Xue's eyes suddenly turned red and she couldn't help but step forward and hug Lu Daosheng.

"Dad."

"Xiaoxue."

The two of them hugged each other, which was moving.

And at this moment, Lu Daosheng suddenly thought of something and then took out the marrow-cleaning pill.

"Come on, Xiaoxue, open your mouth and eat this first."

"good."

Hearing his father's words, Lu Xue did not hesitate at all, and didn't even look at anything, and directly took the marrow washing pill.

Suddenly, a huge amount of medicine instantly filled Lu Xue's limbs and bones.

"Hmm! Dad, what is this?"

Lu Xue felt the abnormality in her body and exclaimed immediately.

"Oh, nothing, it's just a marrow-washing pill."

Lu Daosheng doesn’t care about Tao.

Hearing this, Lu Xue's bright eyes suddenly widened.

Marrow-cleaning pill!

That's it! !

Listen, do you say it? !

However, the next moment, Lu Xue screamed again.

I saw an unpleasant odor emitted from Lu Xue's body, and the black mud dirt gradually appeared on its own surface.

That was when the impurities in the body were cleaned up by the huge medicinal power of the Marrow Cleansing Pill.

Suddenly, Lu Xue hurriedly covered her face and ran out.

He ran and shouted, "Dad, I'll go take a shower first and tell you when I'm back."

He was in place, watching Lu Xue running out in a panic, shook his head and smiled, and then continued to look at the system.

"System, upgrade first."

[Okay, how many levels do the host need to upgrade]

Hearing the system's words, Lu Daosheng immediately began to ponder.

After more than ten years of life in this world of cultivation, he was very cautious in doing things.

If you upgrade, you will improve your cultivation. Although Lu Daosheng has been living in this corner, he still knows that some terrifying powerful people can destroy a city with the wave of their hands.

If your cultivation level is improved too strongly and you don’t pay attention to it and destroy your city, wouldn’t it be worth it?

So to be on the safe side, Lu Daosheng asked, "System, is this upgrade just a simple improvement in cultivation?"

[No, the service of this system is naturally considered for the host in all aspects. Upgrading will not only improve the host's cultivation, but also all the knowledge and skills corresponding to its realm will also be instilled into the host's mind]

[So, the host's worries are completely unnecessary, because the powerful man's control over his own power has reached an unimaginable level]

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng felt relieved.

"System, I have no idea about the future realm. Since you are so considerate, then you can show it to me."

Lu Daosheng originally wanted to say that he was directly at the maximum level, but it seemed unrealistic.

After all, there is no end to cultivation, so how can you say that you have a maximum level?

He still understands this principle.

[Ding, host authorization, has been automatically upgraded for host]

Character panel.

【Name: Lu Daosheng】

【Identity: Lord of the Desert City】

[Land of Realm: Destiny Realm (can be upgraded)]

【System Point: ∞】

【System Store】

The realm of heaven is the realm of Lu Daosheng now.

As the system prompt sound ended, Lu Daosheng suddenly fell into a special state.

At the same time, the unimaginable amount of knowledge is instilling into Lu Daosheng's mind with a terrifying transmission rate.

No one can do such a unique move except the system.

Because such a huge amount of knowledge can instantly burst a person's head, not to mention that Lu Daosheng was only in the spiritual master realm at the beginning.

After a while, Lu Daosheng slowly opened his eyes.

"Is this the realm of destiny?"

Lu Daosheng murmured to himself.

At this time, Lu Daosheng's appearance did not change at all, but his inner self was earth-shaking.

I am the destiny of heaven.

Take charge of the life and death fate of all spirits.

Lu Daosheng looked up and felt it a little. Suddenly, the entire wasteland city, including the wasteland state where the wasteland city is located, was completely visible.

At this moment, all living beings were like ants in his eyes.

He had no doubt at all. As long as he thought, he would destroy the entire wasteland and even the entire Tianxuan world in an instant.

The Destiny Realm is far beyond the Profound Heaven Realm. Lu Daosheng can even feel the place outside the Profound Heaven Realm.

He is now attacking with a dimensionality reduction attack, which is equivalent to attacking the Novice Village at the full level at the beginning.

At this time, Lu Xue's voice sounded again.

"Dad!"

Suddenly, Lu Daosheng quickly restrained his breath and showed a loving smile.

Then, Lu Xue hurriedly ran in with a frown.

Seeing Lu Daosheng, Lu Xue was stunned. Why did she feel that Dad was a little different in the blink of an eye?

But immediately, she remembered her purpose.

"Dad, tell me the truth, where did you get the marrow cleansing pill?"

Lu Xue glared at Lu Daosheng angrily and said.

She didn't know that this look was very cute in Lu Daosheng's eyes.

Looking at his daughter's appearance, Lu Daosheng laughed in his heart, and for a moment, he didn't know what to say.

Seeing Lu Daosheng not speaking, Lu Xue felt a little worried.

"Dad, you didn't sell the City Lord's Mansion, did you?"

She knew that with their family's financial strength, they couldn't afford the Marrow Cleansing Pill.

This was only for the core disciples of the top power. It was no exaggeration to say that one pill could even change a person's fate.

Wait, even if he sold his family, he couldn't afford it. After all, who would want this broken city and this broken City Lord's Mansion?

Could it be that Dad sold himself? !

Impossible, impossible, how could Dad sell himself.

At this time, Lu Xue's heart was extremely active.

Seeing his daughter like this, Lu Daosheng coughed lightly and smiled, "Daughter, Dad is actually very rich."

Hearing this, Lu Xue sighed and said, "Dad, forget it if you don't want to say it."

She knew that her father loved her very much. From childhood to adulthood, they had been dependent on each other.

Now that she had taken the Marrow Cleansing Pill, she must not disappoint her father's expectations and become a strong person as soon as possible so that she could protect her father.

Lu Xue thought about it, and then said, "Dad, I have something to tell you."

At this time, Lu Daosheng, who was still a little confused, reacted and said, "What is it?"

Lu Xue was silent for a moment, and slowly said, "Well~ that's it, a senior said that I have good talent and wants me to worship him as a master, but the condition is that I follow him. Dad, I want to try."

"No!"

As soon as Lu Xue finished speaking, Lu Daosheng said coldly.

I only have such a precious daughter, how can I let her leave me.

What's more, I am no longer the person I used to be.

In just a moment, Lu Daosheng's consciousness locked onto a strong man in the Concentration Realm in the Desolate City.

The realm is divided into Qi Refining, Innate, Spirit Master, Breaking the Air, Concentration, Soul Division, Divine Palace, Life Combination, and Saint.

And this strong man in the Concentration Realm is the strongest person in the Desolate City so far, and Lu Daosheng is not included.

In terms of strength, it is indeed quite good for the current Desolate City, but it is obvious that Lu Daosheng is extremely dissatisfied.

Because Lu Daosheng clearly felt that the Yang Qi of this Concentrated Spirit Realm expert was a little weak, and it was obvious that he had done too much in his daily life. Moreover, he was an old man. If his daughter followed such a guy, he would probably be pissed to death.

Hey, I recognize you, Liangyou Bingshi!

No, no, absolutely not.
